description: Records the latency limit for an escrow job after its createJob transaction confirms, so the oracle knows the SLA to judge. Use it once per job, right after the create_escrow_job transactions. The job is read from the transaction on Base; only its creator's transaction is accepted, and the first registration is kept (calling again does not change it). Writes the terms to AgentSLA's database; moves no funds. Returns jobId and the registered maxLatencyMs. The oracle then settles the job automatically within about 20 minutes (see get_escrow_job).

maxLatencyMs.description: The SLA: the endpoint must answer 2xx/3xx within this many milliseconds, e.g. 1000.

txHash.description: Hash of the confirmed createJob transaction, 0x + 64 hex characters.
